text:
East Coast (PADD 1) distillate inventories 19.3M bbl week ending 28 August — lowest on record (back to 1990);
EIA September STEO: stocks below 100M bbl this month (first since 2003)

"Russia producing 70% of its gasoline needs" rests on one analysis chain (video + DW figures) — directionally supported by the Türkiye import, kept as [AS GIVEN].
Gasoline production ~80k t/d vs 115k t/d domestic demand (~70%)

Jazan (400k b/d) not properly run since 27 July 2026 Houthi drone damage to tank farm and power complex;
nine storage tanks damaged/destroyed by late August
AAA national average: $5.85/gal on 4 September 2026 (GasBuddy), breaking the 17 June 2022 record of $5.819

US diesel crack spread record $112.17/bbl (LSEG, via Edge/Reuters reporting), intraday record $108.02 on 3 September;
pre-war baseline ~$20

Bazan statements: officials' public line on the Haifa refinery strikes was "no significant impact" Interior Ministry documents later showed damage (gas turbines, boilers, a 12,700 m3 tank destroyed beyond repair);
the June strike killed three workers and took the plant fully offline
Vitol and Phillips 66 executives: refined-product deficit structural, more pronounced than crude deficit, into winter

AAA national average: $5.85/gal on 4 September 2026, breaking the 17 June 2022 record of $5.819;
crossed $6 on 10–11 September (AAA $6.06, +63% YoY vs ~$3.71)
The number that measures this is the crack spread — the margin between a barrel of crude and the diesel it becomes.
Rystad's Claudio Galimberti: diesel is "one of the reasons why the government bond yields in the United States are so high"

Canadian crude to PADD 3: 526k b/d (2024) → 416k (2025) → ~337k (H1 2026, EIA Jan–Jun);
total Canadian exports rose — US imports 4M+ b/d H1 2026, June exports +6.4% YoY
